summary: PASS at top level. Both prompt SHAs and the file-level content_sha mismatched the prior cache (dated 2026-07-10) — full regeneration ran against the current on-disk exercise. Prompt 1 (fork the sibling worktree) fires three low-confidence risks: preamble-before-action (unmitigated but low-stakes), default-acceptance (neutralised by the pre-fence body callout naming the base-branch decision), and overwrite-anxiety (neutralised — the copy target is a worktree the same prompt just created, so no prior-file collision is structurally possible). No high or med-confidence risk fires on either prompt, so blocking_findings_count is 0.
